m: The {Joker} skips into the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} and sets up a *small altar* with a birthday cake whose trick candles relight forever. His *big brother* kneels to make a **wish**, blows until he turns purple, and the squirting flower on the altar soaks him. Cackling, the Joker hands him a playing card that reads "**Wish** again".

{Yoshi} waddles {Inside} the {Boathouse} as the *hillside* above tips a *sprouting field* of letters through the door, a landslide of **mail**. His long tongue gulps the lot, then he flutter-jumps from boat to boat laying one speckled egg per address. Rowers crack them at breakfast and find their **mail**, slightly sticky.

{Tarzan} swings on a vine into the {Basement} of the {Pool}, gives his jungle yell, and a giant *mouth* in the wall yells back. Raised by apes, he knows the proper greeting: he shows it how to **spit**. Delighted, the mouth starts to **spit** *soil* in great wet gobs, and the apes line up to catch it.

{Homer} naps in the {Basement} of the {Funfair} with a doughnut on his chest when a *prowling dog* sidles up. Its *glare* is **ruthless**: no blinking, no mercy, and it eats the doughnut one slow bite at a time while he watches. "D'oh!" Homer tries a dim scheme with a decoy doughnut on a string, and the **ruthless** dog eats the string as well.

{James Bond} slips into the {Bathroom} of the {Yen Exchange}, straightens his tuxedo and clicks open a cufflink from Q that does one thing: it lets him **examine** *gold*. A bar of it squeals under the tiny lens and confesses it is chocolate in foil. Unruffled, he pauses to **examine** it once more, then eats the evidence.

{Yoshi} skids on a *plank* in {Front} of the {Ice Rink}, and a chattering *mouth* floats by with something to **say**. His tongue shoots out and swallows it whole, but it keeps talking from his belly. He lays an egg, the egg cracks, and the mouth pops out to **say** "Yoshi!", the only word it has left.

{Shrek} stomps into the {Bathroom} of the {Yeti Cave} wanting only peace, but a *sentry* blocks the door and a *tree* hung with saws and spanners rattles at him. Donkey will not shut up about which **tool** to choose. Shrek roars, every spanner falls off, and he picks the only **tool** an ogre needs: an onion to throw at the sentry.

{Yoshi} flutter-jumps down into the {Basement} of the {Tower}, where a hungry *mouth* on *crossed legs* hops after him, trying to **bite** his tail. His tongue whips out, he gulps it down, and it carries on trying to **bite** him from his own stomach. Hiccup: out plops a spotted egg, gnashing, with two little legs kicking through the shell.

{Lara Croft} climbs {Inside} the {Inn} through a window, ponytail flying, and cracks open a secret tomb door in the wall. A *herald* in the dark trumpets that she has just met her **neighbour**: a mummy in slippers, whose tomb is dug into the *hillside* next door. The *hillside* rumbles and sends a boulder rolling through, and Lara somersaults over it as her new **neighbour** asks to borrow some sugar.

{Charlie Brown} chases his kite into the {Bathroom} of the {Beehive} and walks straight into the door, with every bee watching. His *red cheeks* glow so hot that the towels, the honey and the bees all turn **red** too. "Good grief," he mumbles, while Snoopy, also **red**, waves from the top of the hive.

{James Bond} escapes into the {Basement} of the {Beach} hut to find a *trimmed hedge* filling the whole room. A *helping hand* on a spring, Q's latest gadget, shoots from his briefcase and shoves him in, so he must **squeeze** through the twigs without creasing his tuxedo. He pops out spotless, and the hedge gives a final **squeeze**. "Shaken," he says, "not stirred."

{Walter White} sets up beakers in {Front} of the {Mansion}, adjusts his glasses and dips a straight stick into a class experiment. Out comes a *bent bow*, which twangs and fires test tubes across the lawn, every one landing **bent**. Proud of his precise science, he dips the lamp post too and chalks on the board that it is exactly forty degrees **bent**.

{Yoshi} pads into the {Basement} of the {Beach} hut, where an *oddball* perches on a whole creaking *tree*, insisting it is comfortable. His tongue whips out and swallows the tree in one gulp, leaving the oddball hanging in mid-air. He squats, strains and lays a huge egg, which cracks to reveal a **chair** with bark on it, and the oddball sits on the **chair**, complaining.

{Pikachu} trots {Inside} the {Lake} house as the *hillside* rolls a *spitting mouth* down after him. "Pika!" he says, zapping it with a Thunderbolt, but the mouth only spits cherry stones and insists it will **accompany** him. He hides in his Poké Ball, and it rolls up alongside, spitting politely, to **accompany** the ball instead.

{Gandalf} arrives in {Front} of the {Hut} exactly when he means to, as a *pest* chews the thatch. He raises his staff and mutters a spell, and a *standing knife* rises from the ground and marches off to **cut** the grass by itself. It chases the pest in circles, and at his "You shall not pass!" it stops to **cut** one neat line between them.

{James Bond} strolls in {Front} of the {Yeti Cave}, where a huge *question mark* quivers under a sheet. His bow tie, from Q, fires a *helping hand* that whips the sheet away to **uncover** a yeti in an identical tuxedo. "Bond," says the yeti. Unruffled, Bond tugs at its lapel to **uncover** a smaller yeti, also armed with a one-liner.

{Walter White} teaches {Inside} the {Lake} house in his black hat, lowering a *leather strap* into a beaker of bubbling school chemicals. The strap wriggles out and fizzes letters onto itself, spelling the name **Wei**. Walter nods at his precise science, and Grandpa **Wei** rows up at once to claim his strap and demand full marks.

{Walter White} chalks an equation across the tiles of the {Bathroom} of the {Pool}, while a *speaker* booms the question at his only pupil, a *standing heart*. He drops one indicator into a beaker, it flashes pink, and the heart thumps as it starts to **realise** the answer. Walter, glasses gleaming, is so proud that he doesn't **realise** his hat is fizzing.

{Cookie Monster} lollops in {Front} of the {Lagoon}, where a giant *ear* hears every secret and a *tally* on a slate counts them up. He devours both in a spray of crumbs, and his googly eyes stop spinning: all the facts are in his tummy. "Me **clever** now!" he booms, solving sums for the ducks, and then eats the answers, which is less **clever**.

{Walter White} marches into the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} to do one *chore*: mop the floor, but as a precise experiment. Dry ice meets hot water in his largest beaker while *rain* drips through a crack, and a thick **fog** rolls out. Swimmers walk into each other. Walter, proud, measures it, announces that it is textbook **fog**, and cannot find his glasses.

{Frodo} trudges barefoot in {Front} of the {Jungle} after a very long walk, with *gold coins* pouring down a *peak* behind him, tempting him to stop. He won't, but his bare hairy feet tread them thin until every coin has a **sharp edge**. Sam picks one up, slices a pineapple clean through, and sighs that at least the **sharp edge** keeps them fed.

{Tarzan} swings in {Front} of the {Beach} hut and stops, baffled: his *little brother*, an ape, has pulled a **ladder** out of a *tree*, whose branches are shaking off rungs. Tarzan sniffs it, bites it, and wears it as a hat. Then he yells, and the whole troop of apes climbs the **ladder** on his head.

{Mario} leaps in {Front} of the {Tower} as a *prowling dog* snarls out of a patch of *young crop*. "Wahoo!" He stomps on it, it goes flat with a boing, and up it pops as a **cat**, coughing out one gold coin. He stomps the next dog, collects another coin, and soon every sprouting shoot has a smug **cat** on it.

{Shrek} stomps {Inside} the {Stadium} to demand some quiet, and a *small altar* rolls out with a *sheep* on it, chewing the fans' scarves. He roars at it, and his ogre breath blows the ball straight into the net. Goal! Now the crowd is chanting that the sheep is **lucky**, that ogre breath is **lucky**, and Donkey will not shut up about it.

{Kermit} hops into the {Bathroom} of the {Warehouse} to stage-manage a show, flails his arms and accidentally opens a *gate*. *Living water* pours through, spreading out into a lake so **wide** he can't see the other side. "Yaaay!" he panics, paddling with his banjo, arms flung as **wide** as they will go.

{Yoshi} flutter-jumps into the {Bathroom} of the {Museum} and lands in a surprise *party*, where every statue holds a *speech bubble* full of **praise**. His tongue darts out and he swallows the bubbles one by one. He lays a glittering egg, it hatches, and more **praise** pours out, all of it for him, all of it in his own voice: "Yoshi!"

{Charlie Brown} sets up a stall {Inside} the {Boathouse} selling *longevity peach* tarts on *bamboo* sticks, trying to **raise funds** for a new kite. The bamboo snaps, the peaches roll into the water, and Snoopy eats the rest. "Good grief," he sighs, the only boy ever to **raise funds** and end up owing three cents.

{Cookie Monster} thunders {Inside} the {Lagoon} palace and a *follower* scurries after him carrying a *plank* stacked with cookies, then hundreds more. They huddle so tight they form one bristling **cluster**, planks sprouting like branches. "Me want cookie!" he roars, munching into the **cluster** in a spray of crumbs until only one embarrassed follower remains.

{Chewbacca} pounds in {Front} of the {Yen Exchange} with his bandolier looped around a *big man* like a dog **lead**. He roars directions nobody else understands, so the man trots wherever the tug goes, whimpering and fetching coins. When the man tries to **lead** the way himself, Chewbacca growls, rips a parking meter from the ground and loyally hands it to him as a treat.

{Mario} bounces {Inside} the {Boxing Ring} and head-butts a floating block. Out flies a little *bird*, it opens its *mouth* to **chirp**, and a coin pops out. "Wahoo!" He butts block after block, every **chirp** paying one coin, and the boxers give up the fight to chase the money.

{Sherlock} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Funfair}, pipe in mouth, and studies *water drops* falling on a soggy *pillow*. One dent and one snore are enough: "Elementary, Watson: old Mr **Shen**." Mr **Shen**, asleep under the pillow, rolls over, soaked, as Watson trails behind with a towel.

{Gandalf} ducks {Inside} the {Hut}, bumps his pointy hat on a dusty *loft* and, being cranky, taps it with his staff. With a crackle of fireworks the *loft* unfolds like a flower into a grand **pavilion** with curved eaves and swaying lanterns. He lights his pipe, blows a smoke ring shaped like a second **pavilion**, and declares that it arrived exactly when he meant it to.

{Mario} rises from a warp pipe into the {Bathroom} of the {Pool}, gripping a *grain stalk* whose *shimmer* hushes the room. He takes off his red cap, the taps stop dripping, and every swimmer stands **solemn**, as at a funeral for a mushroom. Even his "Wahoo" comes out as a **solemn** whisper, and he stomps on a rubber duck very, very slowly.

{Chewbacca} arrives in {Front} of the {Museum}, far too huge for its little door, and a *crouching man* beckons him from underneath. He roars, tries to **bend** like him, gets stuck, and rips the door frame off in a temper. Then he loyally rebuilds it even lower, so that now the crouching man has to **bend** double too.

The {Joker} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Beehive} and slaps a trick *edict scroll* on the queen bee's throne, where it unrolls with a honk. It declares that the hive's only **aim** is to make him laugh. Cackling, he takes **aim** with his squirting flower, soaks the bees, and the scroll squirts him right back.

{Shrek} barges into the {Bathroom} of the {Youth Hostel} in a *shirt* with one enormous **sleeve**, just wanting to wash. A *sprouting field* grows out of the cuff: onions, layers upon layers of them, and then Donkey pops up among them, talking. Shrek roars, stuffs him back up the **sleeve**, and peels an onion in peace.

{Lara Croft} vaults into the {Bathroom} of the {Yeti Cave} on a relic **hunt**, and a *prowling dog* sniffs out a trail of *sun-dried meat* for her. Each strip sits on a pressure plate: click, darts; click, a rolling boulder. She backflips over them all, ponytail flying, and the **hunt** ends at a golden idol with a yeti sitting on it, chewing jerky.

{Batman} glides into the {Bathroom} of the {Beach}, where a *pioneer* is boasting that nothing beats his **arm**. Growling, Batman fires a grappling hook through the window at the *moon*, and the moon reels him in by the **arm**, stretching it across the sand. The pioneer hangs his washing on it, and Batman broods, one very long limb still in the sky.

{Sherlock} strides {Inside} the {Hut}, magnifying glass up, and finds a *bug* riding a huge *serpent* like a horse. From one scale he deduces all: "Elementary, Watson: a **snake**, left-handed, fond of jam." The **snake** hisses in amazement, and the bug asks how he knew, as Watson backs slowly out of the door.

{Homer} wakes from a nap in the {Bathroom} of the {Hut} as a *shell* snaps open and fires confetti, and a medal shaped like a *plus sign* lands on his chest. The whole town crowds in to **congratulate** him on the longest nap in history. "Mmm… doughnut," he says, biting the medal, "D'oh!" They **congratulate** him on that as well.

The {Joker} skips into the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} and spots a *tree* holding up the ceiling, a *candle* burning on its tip. Grinning, he paints it to look like a marble **pillar**, then squirts the candle with his flower. It relights, as trick candles do, and everyone who leans on the **pillar** sets off a whoopee cushion while he cackles.

{Pikachu} sparks in {Front} of the {Tower} as a *helping hand* loads Poké Balls into a *catapult*. Each **throw** curves up and comes down on him, and snap, he's caught, and has to zap his way out. "Pika!" he yells, charging himself with a Thunderbolt, and the next **throw** hurls him, glowing, straight at the hand.

{Sherlock} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Pool} and peers through his magnifying glass at a *mortar* rattling by itself, dusted with cheese. One crumb is all he needs. "Elementary, Watson: a **mouse**, left-pawed, recently in Belgium." The mortar tips, the **mouse** strolls out, every bit as smug as he is, and takes his pipe.

{Sailor Moon} trips into the {Bathroom} of the {Hut} and lands on a **zither** with *twin jades* for pegs. Her moon wand touches it, and in a long sparkly transformation the jades begin to pluck the strings alone. A *pinned heart* on the wall throbs along, she bursts into loud tears, and Luna the cat sighs as the **zither** sobs too.

{Gandalf} arrives in {Front} of the {Hut} as crows mob the thatch, and he taps his staff on a rusty *halberd*. It leaps up by itself, spinning, and he thunders, "You shall not pass!" The enchanted **halberd** is as cranky as he is, so it misses every crow and prunes the apple tree instead. Gandalf lights his pipe and pretends the **halberd** meant to.

{Lara Croft} climbs {Inside} the {Tower} and pulls an ancient lever, and down crashes a *roof* of stone bars, trapping her and a *cow* in a tiny **prison**. Ponytail swinging, she solves the rune puzzle in seconds, backflips out and dodges a rolling boulder. The cow moos, chews the key, and stays in **prison**, because the hay is excellent.

{Shrek} stomps into the {Bathroom} of the {Dunes}, where his *grandson*, a tiny ogre, has just built a *road* of gold medals across the sand. Donkey will not shut up about it, but the little ogre blushes and buries them, far too **modest** to look. Shrek grunts that ogres have layers, and one layer, deep under the onion smell, is **modest** too.

{Mario} pops out of a warp pipe in the {Bathroom} of the {Island}, and a *swarm* of bees chases him onto the *road*. He gobbles a mushroom, grows as tall as a lighthouse, and crosses half the island in one giant **stride**. "Wahoo!" Each **stride** stomps a coin out of the ground, and the bees give up, out of breath.

{Chewbacca} wakes from a nap in {Front} of the {Beach} hut to see a **bully** stuffing small kids into a *winnowing basket*. His enormous *yawn* blows off the boy's hat and rumbles into a roar that nobody needs translated. He rips the basket apart in a temper, the kids climb onto his shoulders, and nobody here will ever **bully** anyone again.

{Darth Vader} looms in {Front} of the {Casino}, breathing loudly, and lifts an entire army *camp* into the air with the Force. A giant *mouth* in the sky opens to swallow it, gulping tank after tank, and the weight meter ticks up **ton** by **ton**. Vader booms his disapproval, Force-squeezes its jaw, and it spits every last **ton** back onto the lawn.

{Chewbacca} ducks {Inside} the {Inn} hugging a tiny **zither**, with *twin jades* for pegs and a ticking *clock* at one end. He plucks it with huge hairy fingers, roars along, and snaps every string in a temper when the clock strikes. Then, as with any broken ship, he mends the **zither** with bandolier straps, and it twangs louder than ever.

{Sherlock} kneels in {Front} of the {Wine Cellar}, examining a once-glorious *robe* that frays as he watches, thread by thread. One loose button tells him all: "Elementary, Watson: a noble family in **decline**." His smug grin wilts, his violin goes flat, he guesses Watson's lunch wrong, and Watson notes that the great detective is now in **decline** too.

{Pikachu} scampers {Inside} the {Boxing Ring}, where a glass **bottle** rattles along *linked rails* and smacks into a *tile*. "Pika!" His Thunderbolt runs down the rails, and the lightning ends up trapped in the glass, glowing yellow. The boxers pass it around like a lantern, until someone pops the **bottle** and everyone's hair stands on end.

{Naruto} slurps ramen in the {Basement} of the {Tower}, and a *standing heart* stomps up, **annoyed** at the noise. He summons a shadow clone to say sorry, then fifty more, all slurping and all shouting. By the time the last one pops, the heart is so **annoyed** that it steals his noodles.

{Yoshi} skids into the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion} as glowing *embers* pop in the grate and a little fork-tailed **swallow** darts out. His tongue flicks, gulp, and down goes the bird. He lays one warm speckled egg, it cracks with a puff of sparks, and out flies the **swallow**, tail singed, looking deeply betrayed.

The {Joker} prances into the {Bathroom} of the {Lagoon} and paints a *bullseye* on the tummy of a *standing person*. He flicks a trick playing card that lands dead in the **middle**, squirts water everywhere, then pops into a bunch of flowers. Cackling, he spins the poor victim around until they end up in the **middle** of the room, dizzy, soaked and confused.

{Yoshi} sniffs his way into the {Bathroom} of the {Boathouse}, where a *small speech bubble* floats out from behind a pink *blossom*, whispering about melons, to **lure** him closer. His tongue shoots out and swallows both, bait and whisper. Then he lays them as an egg, sets it by the door, and its muffled melon talk begins to **lure** every duck on the water.

{Lara Croft} vaults {Inside} the {Hangar} with a relic from an old tomb: a cursed platter holding a *good meal*. A *prowling dog* gobbles it, the ancient trap triggers, and the dog swells, grey and shaggy, into a howling **wolf**. Lara flips onto a wing, ponytail flying, and climbs a rope while the **wolf** gnaws the landing gear.

{Charlie Brown} shuffles {Inside} the {Beehive} after his kite, which has fallen in a tiny **pond** fed by falling *water drops*. A *scorpion* sails up on a leaf and pulls the kite away at the last second, exactly as he reaches for it. He topples into the **pond** with a "Good grief" while Snoopy rides past on the leaf.

{Tarzan} swings {Inside} the {Jungle} lodge, misses the vine and smacks into a *sickbed*, and everything starts to **hurt**. His ape family tuck him in and button him into a *winter coat*, which baffles him so much that he tries to eat it. He beats his chest in a jungle yell, which makes it **hurt** even more.

{Lara Croft} abseils {Inside} the {Pool} and prises an ancient *black pot* from the deep-end tiles, a relic with a riddle on its rim. She solves it, the lid flies up, and out pops Grandma **Lu** holding a ladle. The pot rumbles and releases a rolling boulder, and Lara flips over it while Grandma **Lu** calmly scrubs her back.

The {Joker} slides into the {Bathroom} of the {Hangar} and declares **battle** on a *standing person* armed with a *walking staff*. He deals trick cards that burst into streamers, and the staff, secretly rigged, unfolds into a bouquet at every swing. Cackling, he squirts his flower, a white flag pops from the staff, and the **battle** ends in a pile of paper aeroplanes.

{Gandalf} strides into the {Bathroom} of the {Swan Pond} in a burst of fireworks and flicks a *cloth cover* from the smallest swan with his staff. A spell starts the *crowning*: a golden wreath drifts down, and she is **champion** of the whole pond. He puffs his pipe, growls that he always knew, and all the swans honk "**Champion**!"

{Lara Croft} creeps into the {Bathroom} of the {Beach}, where a lone *podium* stands in a shaft of light, holding the relic: a single **grain** of *rice*. She swaps it for a **grain** of sand, the podium sinks with a click, and a rolling boulder chases her out. She backflips clear, ponytail flying, and the rice leaps from her hand, laughing.

{Yoshi} waddles {Inside} the {Tower} as a giant *claw* dangles from somewhere far, far above. He flutter-jumps, legs windmilling, and it is still **distant**. His long sticky tongue shoots up, on and on for miles, but the claw just waves and drifts away until it is a **distant** dot, and the tongue has to come home alone.

{Lara Croft} drops by rope into the {Basement} of the {Museum}, where a dinosaur *spine* hangs across a sealed tomb door. She pulls its bones like levers in the right order, the *spine* starts to dance, and the door grinds open to reveal old Professor **Lü**, trapped since last Tuesday. A boulder rolls after them, and she carries Professor **Lü** over it in one backflip.

{Shrek} stomps {Inside} the {Mint}, grumbling, because a *dark thread* has tied itself to his toe and keeps tugging him through the gloom. It ends at a coin wrapped in layers, like an onion, each layer more **mysterious** than the last. He peels off the final one, finds nothing but Donkey's voice asking questions, and roars at the **mysterious** voice to leave him alone.

{Charlie Brown} runs {Inside} the {Funfair} to kick a football, which is pulled away at the last second. He lands flat on his back, and up fly *crumbs* and *soil* in a great cloud of **dust** that settles on him alone. "Good grief," he coughs, and all day the **dust** follows him onto every ride, like his own small raincloud.

{Frodo} limps {Inside} the {Jungle} on his bare hairy feet, weary of walking, when a *horse* jangling with *icicles* trots up. Its rider, Captain **Feng**, offers a lift, but Frodo, ever reluctant, slips on the Ring and vanishes instead. Captain **Feng** snaps off an icicle, sighs, and offers it to the empty air, where Sam politely takes it.

{Frodo} trudges into the {Basement} of the {Pool}, where a *vanishing man* sobs because he keeps fading away. Frodo knows that feeling, so he slips on the Ring and vanishes too, just to **comfort** him. Now nobody can see either of them, but Sam's *helping hand* pats the air until it finds them, and that does more to **comfort** them than any speech.

{Chewbacca} wades into the {Basement} of the {Yen Exchange} to fix a leak, roaring, as *water drops* patter on his fur. He rips open the tank with *twin blades* from his bandolier, and the flood drains away until it barely wets his ankles. The bank's little submarine bumps along the **shallow** bottom, and he growls and carries it, loyally, across the **shallow** water.

{Darth Vader} breathes loudly in {Front} of the {Casino}, where a grandpa taps his *cane* and demands the **honest** truth at his family *feast*. Vader lifts every hidden card from every sleeve with the Force. Then he points at a boy with a drumstick and booms, "I am your father," and the whole feast gasps, because it is, unfortunately, **honest**.

{James Bond} adjusts his bow tie in {Front} of the {Youth Hostel} and sees a *silk thread* snagged in a *twisted vine*. His watch from Q does one absurd thing: it beeps and pulls anything crooked straight, so he aims it to **correct** them both. Then it goes on to **correct** lamp posts, antennas and a backpacker's spelling. "Straight," he says, "not stirred."

{Zorro} swings down in {Front} of the {Swan Pond}, where a *fortune teller* swears treasure lies under the lawn. He spins his rapier like a **drill**, whirling on one heel, cape flying, and bores a perfect Z into the earth. Up spray *gold coins*, the swans duck, and he rides off laughing, his **drill** of a sword still humming.

{James Bond} strolls in {Front} of the {Boxing Ring} and clicks open a pocket gadget from Q that does just one thing. It sucks a *sun* out of the sky, then another *sun*, then a third *sun*, and squeezes all three into one blazing **crystal**. The boxers squint at the glitter, and Bond checks his hair in the **crystal**. "Bright," he says.

{Chewbacca} hunches over a board game in the {Basement} of the {Beach} hut as a crab wins and blows a *triumph horn*. **How could** a crab beat him? He roars it, in words only friends understand, and rips the board apart in a temper. Then he mends it, the horn blares again, and the roar comes again: **how could** it happen twice?

{Shrek} stomps {Inside} the {Piazza}, where a *mountain* has landed right in his way and the crowds will not leave him alone. Roaring, he prises it apart with giant *tongs*, and a deep **gorge** opens down the middle, perfect for an ogre who wants peace. He settles at the bottom with an onion, and then Donkey's voice comes echoing down the **gorge**, on and on.

{Cookie Monster} charges in {Front} of the {Hangar}, mistaking a *barn* for a giant cookie and the *grass* on it for icing. He devours the lot in a spray of crumbs. Burp: his blue fur slowly turns **dark green**, googly eyes and all. "Me want cookie," he moans, and everything he breathes on goes **dark green** too.

{Pikachu} laps from a *fountain* in {Front} of the {Funfair}, and his cheeks crackle as his *mouth* fills with fizzy pop. "Pika!" The sparks set it off, and he lets out a glowing yellow **spray** over the carousel. The fountain answers with a **spray** of its own, every drop crackling, and the electric horses gallop off.

{Homer} hauls a *plough* into the {Bathroom} of the {Tower}, in a dim scheme to grow doughnuts in a carpet of *fur*. Too lazy to wait, he starts to **consume** the seed doughnuts, then the fur (sprinkles, he thinks), with a long "Mmm…" By noon the plough is scraping bare floor, nothing is left to **consume**, and he says, "D'oh!"

{Lara Croft} races {Inside} the {Boxing Ring} and tackles a *hill climb* of *icicles*, ice axes biting, while a rolling boulder grinds up behind her. At the peak she leaps, ponytail streaming, to **soar** over the crowd with a gleaming relic in her arms. The boulder, inspired, tries to **soar** too, and doesn't.

{Chewbacca} stoops in {Front} of the {Cat Café}, beside a tiny *tower*, and raps with a *tall cane* to **knock** politely. The door falls off. {Tarzan} swings into the {Bathroom} of the {Spa} and, baffled, lands on a tall *stack of papers*: forms, whatever those are. {Yoshi} trots {Inside} the {Mint} and his tongue catches the trailing end of a *long robe*, reeling it in like spaghetti.
